subject: planner: deep copy AST-owned FieldTypes when building expressions (#66652)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff vs parent (planner/core only). Main change is to pass `DeepCopy()` of AST-owned `FieldType` into expression builders (e.g. CAST, scalar functions, IN/LIKE/REGEXP/BETWEEN) and into constants built from `parser_driver.ValueExpr`, preventing expression construction from mutating shared AST state (relevant for prepared statements / plan-cache rebuilds). Confirmed the need via `pkg/expression/builtin_cast.go:2614` where `BuildCastFunctionWithCheck` mutates the provided `tp` (e.g. clears `NotNullFlag`, adjusts flen for BIT→STRING), so sharing would corrupt AST types. Added regression tests in planner to assert no `FieldType` pointer sharing. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`: these `DeepCopy()` call sites remain; no later fix needed/landed for this change.
